label: The Writer
tagline: A page that returns to the same sentence from a different angle.
cluster_explainer: The Broker cluster positions the engine for other people — the deliverable is a forwarded URL, not a pitch. The Writer's broker move is to hand a draft across the room, not to publish it.
demo_highlights: Sphere reads as continuous prose — the same curve across a paragraph, no corners the eye has to negotiate
Cassette preset evokes the written draft: a recording of the work as it sounded the first time, not as it sounds once it's been read aloud by a stranger
Mid-band dominance matches the body of a voice reading prose — where the meaning of a sentence lives, not where the click track would
Smooth envelope (0.7) lets a draft and its revision sit next to each other without one strobing the other out of the page
90s loop is long enough for the writer to leave the room and come back; the demo is the desk, not the published page
